stories.title: 'Big shot Gabby' leads Valkyries' charge from 16 down, ousts Wings in Game 3
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 11 of her 19 points in the fourth quarter to help the Valkyries erase a 16-point second-half deficit and secure a spot in the WNBA semifinals with a 77-73 win over the Wings.

stories.title: Northwestern opens 'electric' Ryan Field with upset of Penn State
stories.summary: Northwestern fans, who eagerly awaited Ryan Field's opening, were rewarded with not only an easy win over a preseason Top 25 team but also a light show and waves of fireworks and flames before kickoff of the Wildcats' 34-13 win over Penn State.

stories.title: Pitt upsets Va. Tech after losing QB; Narduzzi tells pollsters to 'wake ... up'
stories.summary: As his Panthers improved to 5-0 with a 35-33 victory over Virginia Tech, Pittsburgh coach Pat Narduzzi lobbied for his unranked team, sending a message to AP Top 25 voters that he has "a hell of a football team."

stories.title: Vandals' final-play heroics stun No. 1 Montana State, end 19-game win streak
stories.summary: Defending FCS champion Montana State's 19-game win streak is over after Idaho scored a touchdown on the final play of Friday night's game and then scored on a 2-point conversion for a 35-34 victory.

stories.title: Ohtani to play at less than 100% in playoffs, will need to 'manage' injuries
stories.summary: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani says the left knee and right biceps ailments that compromised him throughout the summer are issues he's "just going to have to manage" in the postseason.
